bible_story.title: The church addresses neglected widows
bible_story.narrative: As the number of disciples increased, a complaint arose that Greek-speaking widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution. The apostles gathered the community and proposed appointing seven trusted people to manage the practical responsibility while they continued prayer and teaching. The group chose suitable servants and commissioned them. The account makes clear that a growing church must notice unequal treatment and organise itself to correct it. Spiritual leadership did not excuse neglect of material need.
bible_story.spiritual_lesson: A church that values the Word must also organise fair and accountable care for vulnerable people.
